title: Puharich asks for his papers to be taken away for safety
summary: Unnamed guest tells of Puharich asks for his papers to be taken away for safety, about 1990s at Puharich's house, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: An unnamed researcher on Jesse Michels's podcast passes on what an assistant to Andrija Puharich, a scientist tied to psychic and alien-contact research, said about him in the 1990s. According to the assistant, Puharich said the papers in his house needed to be taken away by someone, because he did not trust giving them to his own children. Told this way, it suggests the papers held something he thought was sensitive or at risk.
